items.title: Convert ChatGPT to Google Doc, Microsoft Word, PDF
items.description: Simply install the extension, navigate to your ChatGPT conversation, select the responses you wish to export, and click the 'Create Google Doc' button.

items.markdown:
You can `use browser extensions or Google Docs add-ons to connect ChatGPT directly to Google Docs` depending on whether you want to export chat logs outward or use ChatGPT inside your documents.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/convert-chatgpt-to-google/iapioliapockkkikccgbiaalfhoieano)[[2]](https://workspace.google.com/marketplace/app/gpt_plus_docs_for_google_docs/669226853089)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/TLyxhPg-ajI)

### 1. Browser Extensions (Export ChatGPT to Google Docs)

To send ChatGPT conversations or single responses directly into a Google Doc with formatting (tables, math equations, and code blocks) preserved:[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-to-google-docs-wo/oibghjgooccojibfacdonaoipegckdeg)[[2]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/convert-chatgpt-to-google/iapioliapockkkikccgbiaalfhoieano)

- **Convert ChatGPT to Google Doc, Microsoft Word, PDF** by Thinksolv Technologies: Install it via the [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/convert-chatgpt-to-google/iapioliapockkkikccgbiaalfhoieano) . Once added, refresh ChatGPT and click the export buttons that appear on responses or at the top of your chat.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/convert-chatgpt-to-google/iapioliapockkkikccgbiaalfhoieano)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eocJi31zMgQ)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/TLyxhPg-ajI)
- **ChatGPT to Google Docs, Word or PDF** : Another popular option available on the [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-to-google-docs-wo/oibghjgooccojibfacdonaoipegckdeg?hl=en) that lets you export single messages or full threads with a single click.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-to-google-docs-wo/oibghjgooccojibfacdonaoipegckdeg)

### 2. Google Docs Add-ons (Use ChatGPT/AI Inside Google Docs)

If you want to write, summarize, or edit content using AI right inside the Google Docs sidebar:[[1]](https://workspace.google.com/marketplace/app/gpt_plus_docs_for_google_docs/669226853089)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tAVBYP9eK2g)

- **GPT Plus Docs for Google Docs™** : Available via the [Google Workspace Marketplace](https://workspace.google.com/marketplace/app/gpt_plus_docs_for_google_docs/669226853089) , this tool integrates OpenAI models (like GPT-4o and DALL·E) to summarize text, fix grammar, and generate images inside your document.[[1]](https://workspace.google.com/marketplace/app/gpt_plus_docs_for_google_docs/669226853089)
- **Alternative Add-ons** : You can also search the Google Workspace Marketplace (via *Extensions > Add-ons > Get add-ons* inside a blank Google Doc) for tools like *GPT for Sheets and Docs*.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tAVBYP9eK2g)
